summary: The app uses zero experimental, preview, RC or canary APIs: the measured experimental marker list is empty and grep confirms no experimental_/unstable_ names, no flags, and no newer subsystems (islands, ClientRouter, Server Islands, Actions). Its entire framework surface is the long-stable SSR path (output 'server', Node standalone adapter, Astro.params/url/response, Astro.self, is:inline) on the current stable releases, astro 7.4.4 and @astrojs/node 11.1.9, both confirmed current via npm and GitHub release notes. Posture is maximally conservative, so upstream-breakage risk is essentially nil; the only minor consideration is caret-range drift within the young 7.x major.
